name: navbar-floating
title: Floating pill navbar
description: Full-width navbar that shrinks into a blurred floating pill on scroll, with a CTA and mobile menu.

standards.purpose: Give visitors one persistent, keyboard-reachable way to move through the site.
useWhen: The site has more than one destination.
doNotUseWhen: A single-screen embed where navigation would be noise.

rules.check: Every menu opens, closes, and is traversable by keyboard; focus returns to the trigger on close.
Below the small breakpoint the nav collapses to a disclosure, never an overflowing row.
